answer: Echo Lag Registry. Each new identity must wait through a random admission window calibrated to network nadir; during that window it may only whisper small probe messages, and its full traffic must arrive along a jetty-shaped ramp: low volume at first, rising slowly over several epochs. Agents whose early traffic spikes or replies arrive faster than the ramp allows get quarantined. Attacker cost: every sybil needs its own aged window, so creating N identities costs N times the ramp duration in wall-clock time, capping burst creation regardless of stake or compute.
